transport: native Swift C2LANRelay; RFC6455 WebSocket IPX relay

actualGameSmoke.basis: Validated version1.3 x86-to-WebAssembly game runtime with original licensed data served only on loopback; two isolated headless Chrome windows

limits: This is a local two-client game smoke test; it is not a full session on two physical Macs or across the Internet.
Native WebKit settings/CSP integration is verified separately by the host integration test.
Unmodified Windows or classic Mac retail games do not connect directly to the WebSocket relay.
The Computer name field sets the runtime computer name; the original in-game Driver field controls the racer nickname.
No original game files, screenshots, installer contents, or personal profiles are included in this verification fixture.
